_notes.loop: /loop-a<->/loop-b; /self; regex ^/blog/ <-> ^/news/; /cross-a (Redirection) -> /cross-b (Rank Math) -> /cross-c (Yoast) -> /cross-a; SmartCrawl /sc-target <-> The SEO Framework (tsf-page); SmartCrawl regex ^/kb/(.+)$ -> /kb/$1 (redirects into itself); /tri-a -> /tri-b -> /tri-c -> /tri-a (Redirection, three nodes); Simple 301 /s301-loop <-> 301 Redirects eps-loop
_notes.chain: /old-about (3 hops); /about-old (2); /promo -> Yoast promo-2024 (2); SRM /careers-old (2); SRM /legacy/* runs into the regex loop; 301 Redirects /eps-old -> Slim SEO eps-mid (2); SmartCrawl /old-seopress -> SEOPress page (2); Rank Math regex ^docs/v1/ -> Slim SEO regex ^docs/v2/ (2); SRM regex /products/([a-z]+) -> Yoast regex ^shop/ (2); /old-faq (3 hops) and /faq-2021 (2) in Redirection; Yoast old-vacatures (2); SRM /srm-old -> Slim SEO srm-mid -> SmartCrawl /srm-end (3) and /srm-mid (2)
_notes.noop: Yoast help/ -> help and downloads/ -> downloads
_notes.duplicate: /dup-source in Redirection, Simple 301 and 301 Redirects, same target; /yoast-dup in Yoast and Rank Math, same target
_notes.shadow: Rank Math redirects the published /services and /partners pages
_notes.broken: Redirection /old-pricing -> /pricing-2019 and /old-brochure -> /brochure-2018; Yoast contact-us -> contact-form-old; SEOPress page seopress-gone -> /gone-for-good (no such content)
_notes.ignored: Redirection /disabled-rule is disabled and must not be reported
_notes.regex: Pattern rules in every plugin that has them: Redirection, Yoast, Rank Math, SRM (wildcard and regex), Simple 301 (wildcard), Slim SEO and SmartCrawl. 301 Redirects, SEOPress and The SEO Framework only hold exact rules.
_notes.404_log: Seven old URLs in Redirection's 404 log (/docs/v1/install, /products/shoes, ...): migrating a pattern into Simple 301 or 301 Redirects copies it as exact rules for these.
_notes.yoast: Free Yoast SEO doesn't run these rules: with only free Yoast active they are leftovers. Re-seeding also removes Yoast copies of seed rules made by Hoptrail's migration.
